## Use case

What are you trying to accomplish? Describe the board, workflow, or pain point.

## Proposed solution

What would you like the plugin to do? Be specific — a new MCP tool, a flag on an existing tool, a workflow change, etc.

## Alternatives you've considered

Other approaches you tried or thought about, and why they fall short.

## Scope

Is this a small tweak, or would it require a new phase of development? Roadmap targets are listed in the README.
